Common.footer: Caring for the places where we learn.
Common.metadataDescription: Receive and track infrastructure issues across the VAST, USTH campus.

Home.title: Every issue acknowledged. Every space cared for.
Home.description: One place to receive reports, follow progress, and help our campus work better every day.
Home.managerDescription: Review incoming issues, their locations and current status to prepare the next steps.
Home.accessNote: Queue data is only available to accounts with management permission.
Home.principleBody: Original descriptions are preserved. The responsible people make the decisions.

Queue.title: Issue queue
Queue.description: Review each issue to prepare its next step.
Queue.emptyTitle: No issues with this status yet
Queue.emptyDescription: Matching issues will appear here when submitted or updated.
Queue.noMatchesDescription: Try another keyword or clear your search to see the loaded issues.
Queue.authDescription: Sign in with a manager account, then try loading the queue again.
Queue.forbiddenTitle: You do not have access to this queue
Queue.forbiddenDescription: This area is for managers. Contact your team manager if you need access.
Queue.errorDescription: Please check your connection and try again later. No data has been loaded successfully.
Queue.partial: This is a partial list. Search only covers the issues already loaded.
Queue.detailNote: Summary information from the queue. Reporter-provided content stays in its original language.
Queue.timezone: Times are shown in Vietnam time (UTC+7).
